translations.web: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
translations.bsb: Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
translations.kjv: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
translations.asv: Moreover the hand of Jehovah was against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, until they were consumed.
